<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import pandas as pd
import csv
import io

# Read the input file
df = pd.read_csv('outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv')

# Identify indicator columns (all columns except city_id, city_name, year)
identifier_cols = ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']
indicator_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col not in identifier_cols]

# Compute missingness per indicator
missingness_data = []
for indicator in indicator_cols:
    missing_count = df[indicator].isna().sum()
    missing_rate = missing_count / len(df)
    kept = missing_rate <= 0.30
    missingness_data.append({
        'indicator': indicator,
        'missing_count': int(missing_count),
        'missing_rate': missing_rate,
        'kept': kept
    })

# Create missingness report DataFrame
missingness_df = pd.DataFrame(missingness_data)

# Write missingness report
missingness_df.to_csv('outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv', index=False)

# Select only kept indicators
kept_indicators = [row['indicator'] for row in missingness_data if row['kept']]

# Create selected matrix
selected_df = df[identifier_cols + kept_indicators]

# Write selected matrix
selected_df.to_csv('outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv', index=False)
</solution_file>
